Usage: retry [options] [--] <command> [args...]

Run a command with automatic retries on failure.

Options:
  --jitter                     Add random jitter to delay (50-100% of calculated value)
  --stdout                     Write summary to stdout instead of stderr (errors still go to stderr)
  -n, --times N                Max retry attempts, not counting initial run (default: 3)
  -d, --delay DURATION         Delay before retries, e.g. 500ms, 2s, 1m (default: 1s)
  -b, --backoff STRATEGY       Backoff strategy: fixed, linear, exp (default: fixed)
  --on CODES                   Retry only on these exit codes (comma-separated)
  --until CODES                Stop when exit code matches (comma-separated)
  -h, --help                   Show help
  --version                    Show version
  --no-color                   Disable colored output
  --json                       JSON output
  --describe                   Structured JSON metadata for AI agents
  --color[=auto|always|never]  Coloured output: auto (default when omitted), always, or never

Examples:
  retry dotnet build                                       Retry a build up to 3 times on failure
  retry --times 5 --delay 2s curl https://example.com/api  Retry HTTP call with delay
  retry --backoff exp --delay 1s --times 6 dotnet test     Exponential backoff
  retry --on 1,2 --times 3 my-script.sh                    Retry only on specific exit codes
  retry --until 42 --times 10 poll-command                 Stop when exit code matches target

Composes with:
  timeit retry --times 3 dotnet build                         Time a build with retries
  peep -- retry dotnet test                                   Watch tests with auto-retry on file change
  retry --until 0 --times 30 --delay 2s nc -z localhost 5432  Wait until a service port accepts connections (wait-for-it replacement)

Exit Codes:
  0    Success (child returned 0) or child exit code pass-through (1–124)
  125  Usage error: no command, bad retry arguments, invalid --on/--until list
  126  Command not
